# Question 7
```{r question 7}

library(rvest)

base_url <- "https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app/exam/registry?start=1"

url    <- base_url
starts <- character()
pages  <- list()

repeat {
  pg <- read_html(url)
  pages[[length(pages) + 1]] <- pg

  # record this page's start value ("none" for the first page if it has no ?start=)
  s <- regmatches(url, regexpr("(?<=start=)[0-9]+", url, perl = TRUE))
  starts <- c(starts, if (length(s)) s else "none")

  # find the "Next" link; adjust the text if the site uses "›" or "Older" etc.
  nxt <- html_element(pg, xpath = "//a[contains(normalize-space(.), 'Next')]")
  if (is.na(nxt)) break
  url <- url_absolute(html_attr(nxt, "href"), url)
  Sys.sleep(1)  # be polite to the server
}

starts            # Q1: the start values across pages
length(pages)     # number of pages

n_per_page <- sapply(pages, function(pg) length(html_elements(pg, ".wreck")))

n_per_page        # wrecks on each page; the last page is often shorter
sum(n_per_page)   # Q1: total wrecks in the registry

```

```{r}
library(rvest)

base_url <- "https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app/exam/registry?start=1"

# 1. Visit every page by following the "Next" link -------------------------
url    <- base_url
starts <- character()
pages  <- list()

repeat {
  pg <- read_html(url)
  pages[[length(pages) + 1]] <- pg

  s <- regmatches(url, regexpr("(?<=start=)[0-9]+", url, perl = TRUE))
  starts <- c(starts, if (length(s)) s else "none")

  nxt <- html_element(pg, xpath = "//a[contains(normalize-space(.), 'Next')]")
  if (is.na(nxt)) break
  url <- url_absolute(html_attr(nxt, "href"), url)
  Sys.sleep(1)
}

# 2. Choose the class selector ------------------------------------------
# Layout A: #w2 is the list, each <li> is one wreck, the class is its <span>
# Layout B: each wreck is its own w-block, the class is the first <li>'s <span>
sel_A <- "#w2 > div > ul > li > span"
sel_B <- "[id^='w'] > div > ul > li:nth-child(1) > span"

n_A <- length(html_elements(pages[[1]], sel_A))
n_B <- length(html_elements(pages[[1]], sel_B))
cat("Matches on page 1 -> layout A:", n_A, " layout B:", n_B, "\n")

class_sel <- if (n_A >= n_B) sel_A else sel_B
cat("Using selector:", class_sel, "\n")

# 3. Scrape the class of every wreck into one vector --------------------
classes <- trimws(unlist(lapply(pages, function(pg) {
  html_text2(html_elements(pg, class_sel))
})))

# 4. Answers and checks -------------------------------------------------
starts                          # Q1: start values across pages
length(classes)                 # Q1: number of wrecks in the registry
head(classes, 10)               # should be class names only
table(classes)                  # look for spelling variants
sum(classes == "Dreadnought")   # Q3: number of Dreadnoughts

```
